title: Exact Planar Black Hole in AdS-Einstein-Scalar Gravity with IR-Emergent Nearly Conformal Fluid
summary: We study an exact static planar hairy black hole of Einstein gravity minimally coupled to a neutral scalar in four dimensions, which arises in a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on AdS$_4\times\mathbb{CP}^3$ dual to the ABJM theory. For nonzero hair the asymptotic region is hyperscaling violating rather than AdS, and the dual theory is a three-dimensional QFT deformed in the UV by an effectively marginally relevant operator with logarithmic running, which flows to the ABJM fixed point in the IR.
